key_insight: The study builds the first large spin-polarized database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing rich electronic and magnetic diversity across more than 2,500 compounds.
engineering_relevance: This dataset helps screen candidate perovskites for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition to band gap, half-metallicity, and bonding trends.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations for Cs2BB'X6 compounds with X = I, Br, Cl, F
Spin-polarized density of states computed for >2,500 predicted-stable double perovskites
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualization and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 719 compounds with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials, providing a broad composition-to-property map.
watch_item: Predictions are computational and limited to compounds judged stable by the tau tolerance factor, so experimental validation is still needed before deployment.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
